   City Council Staff Report
DATE:  DECEMBER 22, 2020
TO:  HONORABLE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL
FROM:  CITY MANAGER’S OFFICE – FINANCE DIVISION
DISTRICT:  ALL
SUBJECT:  ADOPT AMENDED RESOLUTION NO. CC 2020-115, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE
  AUTHORIZING  EXAMINATION  OF  SALES,  USE  AND
  TRANSACTIONS TAX RECORDS

ISSUE
A request for City Council to adopt the following:

  1. The amended Resolution no. CC 2020-115 to authorize the examination of
  sales, use, and transactions tax records with the California Department of Tax
  and Fees Administration (CDTFA)

RECOMMENDATION
Staff recommends that the City Council adopts the following:
  1. The amended Resolution no. CC 2020-115 to authorize the examination of
  sales, use, and transactions tax records with the CDTFA

BACKGROUND
We are requesting the CDTFA to allow the City of Palmdale and our third-party
consultant, Hinderliter, de Llamas and Associates, to examine the sales, use, and
transaction tax records due to the passing of Measure AV to record a ¾ cent
Transactions and Use Tax directly to the City of Palmdale.

DISCUSSION
The CDTFA is requesting a list of City Staff authorized to examine the sales,
transactions and use tax records, and requests to name a third-party consultant firm, if
applicable.

The City staff is requesting City Council to adopt the amended Resolution No. CC 2020-
115 that now includes Section 3. where the firm Hinderliter, De Llamas and Associates
is designated to examine the sales, use and transactions tax records on behalf of the
City of Palmdale. This added language to the resolution is necessary for the firm to
submit its paperwork to the CDTFA for its designation to examine the tax records on
behalf of the City of Pamdale.

  4

FISCAL IMPACT
The amendment to A-6724 with third-party consultant, Hinderliter, De Llamas and
Associates, would increase the total contract amount from $150,000 to $225,000 for
three (3) years, or $25,000 additional cost per year for services related to examination
of sales, use, and transaction tax records relating to ¾ cent Transactions and Use Tax.

STRATEGIC PLAN
Goal II: Ensure long-term fiscal health of the City and maintain funding for services.
  B. Manage resources, costs and liabilities to ensure the City’s long-term fiscal
  health.
  D. Pursue alternative financing opportunities for continued infrastructure
  improvements and quality community programs.

   CITY COUNCIL
  CITY OF PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
  RESOLUTION NO. CC 2020-115

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE
AUTHORIZING EXAMINATION OF SALES, USE AND TRANSACTIONS TAX
RECORDS

  WHEREAS, pursuant to Ordinance No. 1549 of the City of Palmdale, hereinafter
called “District” and Section 7270 of the Revenue and Taxation Code, the District
entered into a contract with the California Department of Tax and Fee Administration
(CDTFA) to perform all functions incident to the administration and operation of the
Transactions and Use Tax Ordinance; and

  WHEREAS, the City Council of the City of Palmdale deems it desirable and
necessary for authorized representatives of the City to examine confidential sales, use
and transactions tax records of the Department of Tax and Fee Administration
pertaining to sales, use and transactions taxes collected by the Department for the City
pursuant to that contract; and

  WHEREAS, Section 7056 of the Revenue and Taxation Code sets forth certain
requirements and conditions for the disclosure of California Department of Tax and Fee
Administration records and establishes criminal penalties for the unlawful disclosure of
information contained in or derived from, the transactions and use tax records of the
Board;

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALMDALE DOES HEREBY FIND, DETERMINE, RESOLVE AND ORDER AS
FOLLOWS:

  SECTION 1. That the City Manager, Assistant City Manager, Director of
Finance, Assistant Director of Finance, Deputy Director of Finance, Finance Manager,
Assistant Finance Manager, Budget Officer, Budget Manager, Supervising Financial
Analyst, Senior Financial Analyst, Financial Analyst or other officer or employee of the
District designated in writing by the City Manager or designee to the California Dept of
Tax and Fee Administration (hereafter referred to as the CDTFA) is hereby appointed to
represent the District with authority to examine transactions and use tax records of the
CDTFA pertaining to transactions and use taxes collected for the District by the CDTFA
pursuant to the contract between the District and the CDTFA. The information obtained
by examination of CDTFA records shall be used only for purposes related to the
collection of the District’s transactions and use taxes by the CDTFA pursuant to the
contract.

  6
 Resolution No. CC 2020-115
Page 2 of 3

  BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the information obtained by examination of
Board records shall be used only for purposes related to the collection of District’s
transactions and use taxes by the Board pursuant to the contracts between the District
and Board.

  SECTION 2. That this resolution supersedes all prior transactions and use tax
resolutions, if any, of the City of Palmdale adopted pursuant to subdivision (b) of
Revenue and Taxation Section 7056.

  SECTION 3. That Hinderliter, de Llamas & Associates is hereby designated to
examine the sales, use and transactions tax records of the Department pertaining to
sales, use and transactions taxes collected for the City by the Department. The person
or entity designated by this section meets all of the following conditions:

  (a)  has an existing contract with the City to examine those sales, use and
transactions tax records;

  (b)  is required by that contract to disclose information contained in, or derived
from, those sales, use and transactions tax records only to the officer or employee
authorized under Sections 1 or 2 of this resolution to examine the information.

  (c)  is prohibited by that contract from performing consulting services for a
retailer during the term of that contract; and

  (d)  is prohibited by that contract from retaining the information contained in, or
derived from those sales, use and transactions tax records, after that contract has
expired.

  SECTION 4. This Resolution shall take effect immediately upon its adoption.

  SECTION 5. The City Clerk shall certify to the adoption of this Resolution.

PASSED, APPROVED and ADOPTED this 22nd day of December, 2020.
